Analytic Cartesian-grid ComputeMeshEngine for an unbounded setting. * Nodes are start + (k_0 d_0, ..., k_{d-1} d_{d-1}), with 0 <= k_i < repetitions_i. Dimension 0 is the fastest flattened index. * Every elementary grid box q, 0 <= q_i < repetitions_i-1, contributes one finite Voronoi vertex at start + (q_i + 1/2) d_i. Its 2^d generators are the corners q + {0,1}^d. The lower corner q is the unique primary owner; all other box corners see the vertex as secondary. * The engine deliberately has no boundary/infinite-edge implementation yet. /
